verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents transaction retrieval by card, merchant and account holder, real-time webhooks for API events, and transaction-time JIT funding. Together these give some visibility into money moving. Nothing in the pack shows a ledger that links authorizations to clearings, or any settlement or reconciliation reporting. Missing for 10: account/card balance endpoints, authorization-to-clearing ledger linkage, settlement reporting, penny-level reconciliation, independent corroboration.
